body.purpose: Default copy outside .jr-pilot; Inter via skin-modern.

title.purpose: Legacy .main-title 2rem; do not use on JR screens.

shadows.name: card-rest-incumbent

components.name: JR Primary Button
components.description: Pilot affirmative action: rectangular jr-button / JRButton on forms, drawers, dialogs.
components.css: .ds-jr-btn-primary { background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #2563eb; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; min-height: 2.5rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-jr-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1d4ed8; border-color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-jr-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: JR Shell Navbar
components.description: Target App Shell: deep blueprint bar with JR tokens + PrimeVue menus — not Bootstrap .navbar-modern.
components.html: JobRhythmInventoryContracts
components.css: .ds-jr-shell-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: #1e3a8a; color: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #172554; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-jr-shell-brand { font-weight: 700; margin-right: 0.75rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-jr-shell-link { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-jr-shell-link-active, .ds-jr-shell-link:hover { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-jr-shell-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #93c5fd; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: JR Work Surface
components.description: Pilot page chrome: cool gray page + white panel, 1px border, no mega-card shadow.
components.css: .ds-jr-page { background: #f3f4f6; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; text-align: left; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-jr-panel { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; box-shadow: none; } .ds-jr-title { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 1.3125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-jr-muted { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #4b5563; }

components.name: JR Text Input
components.description: Pilot field: rectangular control, single primary border on focus — no halo ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-jr-label" for="ds-search">Search</label><input id="ds-search" class="ds-jr-input" type="search" placeholder="Search products…" />
components.css: .ds-jr-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-jr-input { width: 100%; max-width: 320px; display: block; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; min-height: 2.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #111827; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-jr-input:hover { border-color: #d1d5db; } .ds-jr-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #2563eb; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: JR Data Table
components.description: Pilot table: white surface, muted header, 1px borders, dense cells.
components.css: .ds-jr-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-jr-table thead th { background: #f9fafb; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; color: #111827; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-jr-table tbody td { padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; color: #111827; } .ds-jr-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f9fafb; }

components.name: JR Badge
components.description: Rectangular status chip; light background + strong text (e.g. Active).
components.css: .ds-jr-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-jr-badge-success { background: #DEF2E6; color: #166534; border-color: #bbf7d0; }

narrative.overview: JobRhythm admin is a Construction Operations / ERP console. CURRENT STATE still ships Vue 3 + Bootstrap 5 with a skin-modern.css overlay on unmigrated screens. TARGET STATE (Pilot) is the frontend-upgrade contract: JR tokens, JRPage/.jr-pilot features, PrimeVue styled mode, and App Shell (Navbar/Footer) migrated off Bootstrap onto the same JR/PrimeVue authority — not a permanent Bootstrap island.
keyCharacteristics: Operate mode: data-dense tables, filters, and forms for residential trade contractors
Target: feature view | App Shell → JR primitive → PrimeVue → JR tokens
Pilot palette: neutrals + one action blue; 1px borders over heavy card shadows
App Shell in scope: Navbar/Footer leave .navbar-modern / Bootstrap collapse for JR + PrimeVue
Coexistence: Bootstrap remains only on unmigrated feature screens until each wraps in JRPage

rules.name: Layered Source Rule
rules.body: Treat skin-modern.css + NavbarComponent as the visible incumbent until those surfaces migrate; do not assume custom-bootstrap.scss alone describes the UI. Target State still requires shell migration off Bootstrap.

rules.name: Status Semantics Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, danger, and info colors must remain unambiguous for operational states. Pilot warning/info use JR tokens (#d97706 / #0284c7), not Bootstrap amber/cyan.

rules.name: Density Rule
rules.body: Prefer readable operational density; avoid marketing-scale whitespace inside modules.

rules.name: Single Global Layer Rule
rules.body: During upgrade, consolidate to one global style authority; avoid adding a fourth parallel global skin.

rules.name: App Shell In Scope Rule
rules.body: Navbar and Footer must adopt JR tokens + PrimeVue. Impeccable and design-reviewer must score the shell against Target State; do not ignore shell files as out of pilot scope.

dos: Do wrap migrated feature screens in JRPage / .jr-pilot.
Do migrate Navbar / Footer onto pilot tokens and PrimeVue (JR shell / thin adapters); treat App Shell as part of the frontend upgrade, not a permanent Bootstrap island.
Do use JR primitives instead of one-off PrimeVue markup in features; for shell menus/buttons, prefer JR wrappers or a documented PrimeVue pattern over Bootstrap classes.
Do put operational field help under the control (JRField hint + aria-describedby), not in a hover-only tooltip.
Do use PrimeVue Message (info, not closable) for a consequence that appears after a choice.
Do keep form fields and select/datepicker overlays rectangular (--radius-jr-control: 0).
Do use InputNumber mode=decimal locale=en-US with 2 fraction digits for money/amount fields; coerce empty to 0.00.
Do keep JRDialog / p-dialog rectangular (border-radius: 0), like the product images dialog.
Do use a single primary border for field focus — never a double ring.
Do use JRButton in forms, drawers and dialogs; Delete is filled danger, label-only.
Do let Impeccable and jobrhythm-design-reviewer score Navbar / Footer against this Target State (no shell is out of scope waiver).
donts: Don't enable Tailwind Preflight or migrate the build to Vite while Bootstrap still owns unmigrated screens — unless Preflight is proven safe.
Don't keep Navbar / Footer on Bootstrap / skin-modern as the target; do not leave Bootstrap collapse/dropdown/btn chrome as intentional long-term shell.
Don't nest Bootstrap .card / .card-modern inside JRPage as an outer chrome.
Don't use the incumbent centered 2rem title or 1.25rem mega-card radius on pilot screens.
Don't hint every field or duplicate the same sentence in hint and tooltip.
Don't teach a commercial or stock rule only with JRTooltip / (i).
Don't round JR inputs, selects, or dropdown panels.
Don't round JRDialog / p-dialog (header, content, or footer). Never apply --radius-jr-panel to dialogs.
Don't stack outline + border (or a focus shadow) on the same field.
Don't use ghost icon+label JRRowActions inside a drawer, or a text-link Delete.
Don't add detector ignores that exempt Navbar / Footer from pilot color/type/radius rules because shell is Bootstrap.
